name: Tvg_Mask_Method
brief: Enumeration indicating the method used in the masking of two objects - the target and the source.

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_ALPHA
members.brief: Alpha Masking using the masking target's pixels as an alpha value.

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_INVERSE_ALPHA
members.brief: Alpha Masking using the complement to the masking target's pixels as an alpha value.

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_LUMA
members.brief: Alpha Masking using the grayscale (0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722*B) of the masking target's pixels.

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_INVERSE_LUMA
members.brief: Alpha Masking using the grayscale (0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722*B) of the complement to the masking target's pixels.

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_ADD
members.brief: Combines the target and source objects pixels using target alpha. (T * TA) + (S * (255 - TA))

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_SUBTRACT
members.brief: Subtracts the source color from the target color while considering their respective target alpha. (T * TA) - (S * (255 - TA))

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_INTERSECT
members.brief: Computes the result by taking the minimum value between the target alpha and the source alpha and multiplies it with the target color. (T * min(TA, SA))

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_DIFFERENCE
members.brief: Calculates the absolute difference between the target color and the source color multiplied by the complement of the target alpha. abs(T - S * (255 - TA))

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_LIGHTEN
members.brief: Where multiple masks intersect, the highest transparency value is used.

members.name: TVG_MASK_METHOD_DARKEN
members.brief: Where multiple masks intersect, the lowest transparency value is used.
